title: Scenarios: irrigation
intro: The irrigation question compares rainfed and irrigated crops of the built-in rotation. The trigger is the potential at 20 cm below which the overhead irrigation starts; the water per irrigation is fixed.

marks.d: The soil profile of the run: the built-in loam or sand, or your own soil when it is set in My data.
Irrigation starts when the soil water potential at 20 cm drops below this value (cm).
Depth of water applied each time (mm).
Multiplies the rain of the weather file (1 leaves it as recorded).
Added to every daily temperature (degrees Celsius).
First year of the simulation; it must lie at least one year after the start of the weather.
The one weather choice of every Daisy simulation: the weather of the SWAFL project when one is loaded, the built-in Taastrup weather, a built-in station, online weather or a file.
Each ticked run is one Daisy simulation; the figures compare them.
Tick the processes of Fig. 1 whose figures should be drawn as well, or write them in words.
Runs every ticked simulation and draws the figures.
Puts every option back to its standard value.
Saves the set-up files of the first ticked run, to run Daisy anywhere.
